question: Should this timeline request wait for the metadata-only audit ledger and lifecycle security contract, or should maintainers intentionally scope a narrower ephemeral timeline surface now?
rationale: The useful user outcome is clear, but the implementation choice controls persistence, cross-session visibility, redaction, and whether this duplicates existing Activity/trajectory state.

options.title: Build on audit ledger first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 to define durable metadata, authorization, redaction, and query semantics before adding the timeline UI/CLI surfaces.

options.title: Approve ephemeral timeline only
options.body: Keep the surface browser/session-local and derived from existing live events, accepting that it will not satisfy durable JSON export or historical timelines.

options.title: Decline broad timeline
options.body: Keep Activity and trajectory export as the supported observability paths and close or narrow this issue after documenting that decision.

recommendation.title: Build on audit ledger first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 to define durable metadata, authorization, redaction, and query semantics before adding the timeline UI/CLI surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the related metadata-only audit foundation and appears in current-main history for adjacent activity and subagent lifecycle paths.
